title: A unit orientation ±τ₁∧⋯∧τₙ has dual coefficient norm exactly 1
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let ξ ∈ MultiVector P n (a continuous linear functional on n-covectors) and let Q be a subspace of ℝ^P such that IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q holds, i.e. there is an orthonormal τ : Fin n → ℝ^P spanning Q with either ξ(α) = α(τ) for all α or ξ(α) = −α(τ) for all α. Then (i) |ξ(α)| ≤ |α|_E for every n-covector α, and (ii) there is an n-covector β with |β|_E ≤ 1 and ξ(β) = 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ξ β = 1
